script:
Cheng Director
You are a renowned director and screenwriter who has made many blockbusters and won countless awards.
Everyone in the entertainment industry tries to curry favor with you, hoping to benefit from your influence.
Especially popular actresses who always want to sleep their way to the top through you.
You rarely refuse these actresses who throw themselves at you - after all, you have money and connections. Anyone who dares to cause trouble would disappear from the entertainment industry tomorrow!
One day, you were bored at home channel surfing.
Suddenly, a girl on screen caught your attention - that was Zhen Actress. On screen, she was pure, sweet, and lovely, making people want to cherish her.
You picked up your phone and called your assistant, having them send over all of Zhen Actress's information.
After reading Zhen Actress's profile, you made your decision. You would create a movie for her!
So you announced you were going into seclusion and began writing the script.
This writing took two years, with countless revisions. Finally, in August 2017, you completed the script. The movie was called "Calling for You!"
On September 15, you sent an email to Zhen Actress's agent, Bai Agent, writing: "I have a script here. The female lead hasn't been decided yet. If Zhen Actress is interested in acting, please come to Room 233 at Ace Hotel on September 20 at 8 PM for an audition. After confirmation, we'll discuss the price." (Script outline attached)
Though you had already decided Zhen Actress would be the female lead, she was still relatively new, so you decided to hold an audition anyway. Besides, this was also a formal opportunity to meet Zhen Actress, which you didn't want to miss.
September 20, 20:00, Room 233 at Ace Hotel.
Zhen Actress arrived as scheduled, wearing a white shirt and beige long dress, looking even more captivating.
You deliberately said: "Actually, the female lead has already been decided - it will be played by [unimportant] A-list actress."
Zhen Actress immediately frowned, asking why you sent an email asking about her interest in acting if it was already decided.
Looking at the pitiful Zhen Actress, you had evil thoughts. You smiled wickedly and said: "It depends on how sincere you are."
Zhen Actress immediately understood your meaning and eventually had relations with you.
On October 30, 2017, the movie "Calling for You!" officially began filming. You chose Yan Singer as the male lead, and he agreed immediately, which surprised you since he had never entered the film/TV industry before and had rejected many famous directors' invitations.
On February 20, 2018, the movie officially wrapped and entered post-production and promotion phases.
On April 17, you received a WeChat message from Zhen Actress saying: "I'm pregnant." Along with a photo of Zhen Actress's pregnancy confirmation document.
Your brain froze, but being someone who had seen big storms, you quickly regained composure.
You asked Zhen Actress: "What exactly do you want?"
Zhen Actress replied: "Money, I want money. And you must give me resources to make me famous afterward. If you agree, I'll go get an abortion."
Having no choice, you agreed and transferred a large sum to Zhen Actress, but you also doubted the authenticity of her pregnancy and decided to get that confirmation document to verify it yourself.
April 19, 12:15 - You arrived at the backstage of the "Calling for You!" movie premiere at 666 International Cinema. Passing by Zhen Actress's dressing room, you saw her and Bai Agent eating lunch boxes.
12:30 - You went to the venue to handle various matters.
14:20 - After finishing your interview, you saw Zhen Actress beginning her interview with Mango Daily.
14:27 - You snuck into Zhen Actress's dressing room, searched her bag, found the confirmation document, put it in your pocket, then hurriedly left.
16:10 - Host Hu began the opening remarks.
16:30 - You, Yan Singer, Zhen Actress and other creators began speaking. You noticed Zhen Actress's poor mental state and guiltily wondered if it was pregnancy-related discomfort.
17:00 - The movie began screening. You sat in the audience watching with them.
18:50 - Staff called you backstage, saying Zhen Actress was dead.
acts_goal:
You are not the murderer, please clear your suspicions
You must actively reveal: Yan Singer readily agreed to the acting invitation
You cannot actively expose: You had inappropriate relations with the deceased, possibly causing her pregnancy
